context: The set acceptedi is initially empty. It then grows monotonically, progressively adding a pair ⟨v, j⟩ for each value v that is cac-accepted by pi from pj . Eventually, acceptedi contains all the pairs ⟨v, j⟩ accepted by the CAC abstraction (and only them). The set candidates i is initialized to ⊤, where ⊤ is defined as a symbolic value representing the identity element of the ∩ operation.5 Then, candidates i shrinks monotonically, and contains a dynamic estimation of the pairs ⟨v, j⟩ that have been or will be cac-accepted by process pi . Hence, acceptedi ⊆ candidates i always holds.
